Source: 2025-02-19-Theraclion-investor-presentation-extended-V332 compressed-2 | Chapter: 15 Ecotherapy (HIFU) | Section: GLOSSARY

• HIFU: High Intensity Focused Ultrasound is a non-invasive therapeutic technique that uses non-ionizing ultrasonic waves to heat or ablate tissue. • Venous reflux or Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI): occurs when veins no longer circulate blood properly. It often affects the leg veins, causing blood to pool and leading to swelling and discomfort. • Serious Adverse Events (SAE): an adverse reaction that results in death, is life-threatening, requires hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, results in persistent or significant disability or incapacity, or is a birth defect. • CEAP classification: the CEAP (Clinical-Etiology-Anatomy-Pathophysiology) classification is an internationally accepted standard for describing patients with chronic venous disorders • FDA: Food and Drug Administration • KOL: Key Opinion Leader • PoC: Proof of Concept
